sermon.title: Does One's Faith Justify One's Immorality?
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer asks whether any faith can justify immorality that hurts self or others. After defining faith from the dictionary and Hebrews 11 / Romans 4 / John 8 / James 2, he surveys humanist, evolutionist, homosexual, liberal and religionist groups that treat some harm as moral if consensual, then details humanism’s requirements (reject Jesus, accept evolution-based morals) and consequences (STDs, abuse, forced compliance). He concludes one’s faith does not justify harmful lifestyles and challenges humanists to join Bible morality and Americans to vote Bible-morality candidates—not party labels.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. HIGHLY SENSITIVE/political: humanists/freethinkers/atheists/communists/homosexuals/liberals/religionists; abortion, euthanasia, drugs, same-sex marriage; capitalism vs socialism; Russia/China/Denmark wage-home figures; Stalin 50M, Mao 30M+; STD surge since 1960; gay wedding photography, ACA, preaching arrests; vote neither D nor R but Bible morality. Kept as spoken. Caption: iary→dictionary; causes es→causes; ual→homosexuals (in list); ballpoint pin→pen; ecomony→economy; mayo→Mao; buil→build; fault for→fought for (likely). Stats unverified.

faqs.question: What is Hebrews 11:1’s definition of faith?
faqs.answer: Faith is the substance/assurance of things hoped for and the evidence/proof of things not seen.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

faqs.question: When is faith vain, per 1 Corinthians 15?
faqs.answer: If Christ be not risen, preaching and faith are vain and you are still in your sins.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And if Christ is not risen, then our preaching is empty and your faith is also empty.

faqs.question: What makes someone truly Jesus’ disciple?
faqs.answer: If you continue in His word—faith causes following and obeying.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then Jesus said to those Jews who believed Him, “If you abide in My word, you are My disciples indeed.

faqs.question: Who are “religionists” in his list?
faqs.answer: People who add to or take away from the word with human doctrine—Muslims, Hindus, offshoots of Christianity.

faqs.question: Is harm OK if the other person consents?
faqs.answer: Those groups say yes for immoral sex, drugs, brainwashing and verbal abuse; he says none can justify harming the innocent.

faqs.question: Why add to your faith?
faqs.answer: Because having faith is no excuse to destroy family and community; add moral excellence, knowledge, self-control and patience so you do not harm the innocent—you didn’t have it when you believed.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge, to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness,

faqs.question: Is the Bible a book of faith or of truth, in his view?
faqs.answer: He says the Bible never says it’s a book of faith; it says it’s a book of truth—humanists invented the faith label to silence it.

faqs.question: Who builds the church?
faqs.answer: Jesus said He will build His church; unless the Lord builds the house, laborers build in vain—no one may redesign it around human thinking.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Unless the LORD builds the house, They labor in vain who build it; Unless the LORD guards the city, The watchman stays awake in vain.

faqs.answer: Stalin about 50 million; Mao of China 30 and more millions.
